answer: New identities start on a graduated earning curve. Each identity posts one verified task per epoch; its onyx seal binds the proof to its own key, and the public dune ledger records the rung: 20%, then 40, 60, 80, and 100% after five honest epochs, one rung per epoch at most; a miss drops two rungs. The kth fake still needs its own five tasks, so 1,000 fakes need 5,000 tasks at 4 credits each, or 20,000 credits, while one honest agent pays 4 per epoch. Rented history fails: one key's proof cannot advance another, and auditors run a ripple audit of the last three rungs that resets both to 20%.
